comment: A capture file: fog and mist over the fixture dungeon, for the screen test alone (D-187, D-889). The fog is a fractal noise of three layers in the pale gray key `L`, which the fog shader of Game fades smoothly from clear to the strength of each layer, at the pixel size of the art, in one pass (D-897, D-898, D-900, D-901, D-903). Wide banks drift east, smaller clouds drift east faster, and thin wisps drift west. The density is even over the view, and the thickest part is 45 percent (D-902, D-905). Where layers overlap, the strongest layer wins (D-899). The fog draws above the figures, and its full strength keeps each enemy of the map visible (D-885, D-886, D-892, D-906). The mist under it is a slow stream of pale motes.
